parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Client-generated key (1-128 printable ASCII characters, a UUID per
logical submit). A retry reuses it; a new user action mints a new
one. Same key and same request replays the stored answer with
Idempotency-Replayed: true when that answer is final for the
request; the same key with a different request is 409
idempotency-key-reused. A refusal whose problem type is RETRYABLE
(its cause can change) is not stored: the key is released and the
retry executes again (replay classes, ADR 0024).
